responsibility: Declares the substitution framework embedded in generic TyTy types. It defines the mapping from HIR type parameters to ParamType placeholders, the argument objects and mapping sets used to instantiate them, and the SubstitutionRef mixin that generic ADTs/functions/projections use to answer whether substitution is needed, infer or apply mappings, solve receiver-driven substitutions, and monomorphize associated higher-ranked trait bounds.
same_name_distinction: Defines the substitution data structures and abstract API for this stem—parameter mappings, substitution arguments, argument sets, and the SubstitutionRef interface—whereas the .cc file provides their concrete algorithms and resolution behavior.
